notes: All figures from the Porsche AG Annual and Sustainability Report 2025 (consolidated financial statements, IFRS), fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, on investorrelations.porsche.com. EUR, converted exactly from € millions. LEADER: Oliver Blume was Chairman of the Executive Board (CEO) for all of fiscal 2025 and left the Executive Board by mutual agreement effective midnight December 31, 2025, to focus on Volkswagen AG; Dr. Michael Leiters became CEO on January 1, 2026 (Half-Year Financial Report 2026). Relation is therefore former-ceo. The report does not disclose Blume's personal holding of Porsche AG shares (no shareholding table), so status is 'not-disclosed'. HOLDERS: percentages are of total share capital (ordinary plus preferred), as the chart states, so they are economic; Volkswagen's 75.4% and Porsche SE's 12.5% are separate holdings and do not overlap. The report states the structure of investments was unchanged from 2024. No other individual preferred-share holder is disclosed. DIVIDENDS: €2,100 million paid to Porsche AG shareholders in 2025 (statement of changes in equity); the cash-flow line 'Dividends' of €2,101 million includes €1 million to non-controlling interests. BUYBACKS: 0; the cash-flow statement has no line for purchases of own shares and the share count stayed at 455,500,000 of each class. STOCK COMP: null. Share-based payment (note 43) is cash-settled performance share plans for the Executive Board and management, plus an IPO bonus whose final tranche was paid in 2025; no shares are granted. The note gives the expense in parts (Executive Board and top management: total expense of –€5 million; other management: €20 million; IPO bonus: 0) without a company-wide total, so no figure is recorded rather than summing. GEOGRAPHY: the five regions as reported; the 'Hedges sales revenue' column of €232 million is omitted, so the segments sum to €36,039 million against the Group total of €36,272 million.
